extra_verification.description: Specifies the level of further verification when device authorization is enabled. The PingOne platform performs an extra verification check by sending a "silent" push notification to the customer native application, and receives a confirmation in return.  By default, the PingOne platform does not perform the extra verification check.  Options are `permissive` (the PingOne platform performs the extra verification check. Upon timeout or failure to get a response from the native app, the MFA step is treated as successfully completed), `restrictive` (the PingOne platform performs the extra verification check. idp_id.description: **Required** when the `type` is one of `SOCIAL_LOGIN_BUTTON`.  A string that specifies the external identity provider's ID.

idp_name.description: **Required** when the `type` is one of `SOCIAL_LOGIN_BUTTON`.  A string that specifies the external identity provider name.

idp_type.description: **Required** when the `type` is one of `SOCIAL_LOGIN_BUTTON`.  A string that specifies the external identity provider type.  Options are `AMAZON`, `APPLE`, `FACEBOOK`, `GITHUB`, `GOOGLE`, `LDAP`, `LINKEDIN`, `LINKEDIN_OIDC`, `MICROSOFT`, `OPENID_CONNECT`, `PAYPAL`, `SAML`, `TWITTER`, `YAHOO`.

input_type.description: **Required** when the `type` is one of `AGREEMENT`, `SINGLE_CHECKBOX`.  A string that specifies the type of field.  Options are `BOOLEAN` (available when the field `type` is `SINGLE_CHECKBOX`), `READ_ONLY_TEXT` (available when the field `type` is `AGREEMENT`).

key.description: **Required** when the `type` is one of `AGREEMENT`, `CHECKBOX`, `COMBOBOX`, `DEVICE_AUTHENTICATION`, `DEVICE_REGISTRATION`, `DROPDOWN`, `FIDO2`, `FLOW_BUTTON`, `FLOW_LINK`, `PASSWORD`, `PASSWORD_VERIFY`, `PHONE_NUMBER`, `POLLING`, `QR_CODE`, `RADIO`, `SINGLE_CHECKBOX`, `SOCIAL_LOGIN_BUTTON`, `TEXT`, optional when the `type` is one of `SLATE_TEXTBLOB`.  A string that specifies an identifier for the field component.

label.description: **Required** when the `type` is one of `CHECKBOX`, `COMBOBOX`, `DEVICE_AUTHENTICATION`, `DEVICE_REGISTRATION`, `DROPDOWN`, `FIDO2`, `FLOW_BUTTON`, `FLOW_LINK`, `PASSWORD`, `PASSWORD_VERIFY`, `PHONE_NUMBER`, `RADIO`, `SINGLE_CHECKBOX`, `SOCIAL_LOGIN_BUTTON`, `SUBMIT_BUTTON`, `TEXT`.  A string that specifies the field label.

label_mode.description: Optional when the `type` is one of `CHECKBOX`, `COMBOBOX`, `DROPDOWN`, `PASSWORD`, `PASSWORD_VERIFY`, `PHONE_NUMBER`, `RADIO`, `SINGLE_CHECKBOX`, `TEXT`.  A string that specifies how the field is rendered.  Options are `DEFAULT`, `FLOAT`.

label_password_verify.description: Optional when the `type` is one of `PASSWORD_VERIFY`.  A string that when a second field for verifies password is used, this property specifies the field label for that verify field.

layout.description: **Required** when the `type` is one of `CHECKBOX`, `RADIO`, optional when the `type` is one of `COMBOBOX`, `DROPDOWN`, `PASSWORD`, `PASSWORD_VERIFY`, `TEXT`.  A string that specifies layout attributes for radio button and checkbox fields.  Options are `HORIZONTAL`, `VERTICAL`.

description.description: Description for the device (Max 1000 characters). Supported when the parent field `type` is `DEVICE_AUTHENTICATION` or `DEVICE_REGISTRATION`.

icon_src.description: Icon image source to display for the device (Max 500 characters). Supported when the parent field `type` is `DEVICE_AUTHENTICATION` or `DEVICE_REGISTRATION`.

label.description: A string that specifies the option's label in the form field that is shown to the end user. Supported when the parent field `type` is one of `CHECKBOX`, `COMBOBOX`, `DROPDOWN`, `RADIO`.

title.description: Title for the device. Supported when the parent field `type` is `DEVICE_AUTHENTICATION` or `DEVICE_REGISTRATION`.

type.description: Device type. Supported when the parent field `type` is `DEVICE_AUTHENTICATION` or `DEVICE_REGISTRATION`.  Options are `EMAIL` (available when the parent field `type` is `DEVICE_AUTHENTICATION` or `DEVICE_REGISTRATION`), `FIDO2` (available when the parent field `type` is `DEVICE_AUTHENTICATION` or `DEVICE_REGISTRATION`), `MAGIC_LINK` (available when the parent field `type` is `DEVICE_AUTHENTICATION`), `MOBILE` (available when the parent field `type` is `DEVICE_AUTHENTICATION` or `DEVICE_REGISTRATION`), `SMS` (available when the parent field `type` is `DEVICE_AUTHENTICATION` or `DEVICE_REGISTRATION`), `TOTP` (available when the parent field `type` is `DEVICE_AUTHENTICATION` or `DEVICE_REGISTRATION`), `VOICE` (available when the parent field `type` is `DEVICE_AUTHENTICATION` or `DEVICE_REGISTRATION`), `WHATSAPP` (available when the parent field `type` is `DEVICE_AUTHENTICATION` or `DEVICE_REGISTRATION`).

value.description: A string that specifies the option's value in the form field that is posted as form data. Supported when the parent field `type` is one of `CHECKBOX`, `COMBOBOX`, `DROPDOWN`, `RADIO`.

options.description: **Required** when the `type` is one of `CHECKBOX`, `COMBOBOX`, `DEVICE_AUTHENTICATION`, `DEVICE_REGISTRATION`, `DROPDOWN`, `RADIO`.  An array of objects that specifies the unique list of options. For `DEVICE_AUTHENTICATION` and `DEVICE_REGISTRATION`, this is a list of available devices, which must not be empty, and each option object supports `type`, `title`, optional `description`, and optional `icon_src`. For `CHECKBOX`, `COMBOBOX`, `DROPDOWN`, and `RADIO`, each option object supports `label` and `value`.

other_option_attribute_disabled.description: A boolean that specifies whether the other option is disabled.

other_option_enabled.description: A boolean that specifies whether the end user can type an entry that is not in a predefined list.

other_option_input_label.description: A string that specifies the label placeholder text for the other option in drop-down controls.

other_option_key.description: A string that specifies the key associated with the other option.

other_option_label.description: A string that specifies the label for a custom or "other" choice in a list.

polling_appearance.description: **Required** when the `type` is one of `POLLING`.  A string that specifies the polling activity indicator appearance.  Options are `DOTS`, `NONE`, `SPINNER`.

col.description: An integer that specifies the column position of the form field in the form  (min = `0`; max = `3`).

row.description: An integer that specifies the row position of the form field in the form (maximum number is `50`).

width.description: An integer that specifies the width of the form field in the form (in percentage).

position.description: A single object that specifies the position of the form field in the form.  The combination of `col` and `row` must be unique between form fields.

required.description: Optional when the `type` is one of `CHECKBOX`, `COMBOBOX`, `DEVICE_AUTHENTICATION`, `DEVICE_REGISTRATION`, `DROPDOWN`, `PASSWORD`, `PASSWORD_VERIFY`, `PHONE_NUMBER`, `RADIO`, `SINGLE_CHECKBOX`, `TEXT`.  A boolean that specifies whether the field is required.

show_extension.description: Optional when the `type` is one of `PHONE_NUMBER`.  Whether to show an extension field.  Defaults to `false`.

show_password_requirements.description: Optional when the `type` is one of `PASSWORD`, `PASSWORD_VERIFY`.  A boolean that specifies whether to display password requirements to the user.

size.description: **Required** when the `type` is one of `POLLING`, `QR_CODE`, `RECAPTCHA_V2`.  A string that specifies the reCAPTCHA size or the QR code/polling size. For reCAPTCHA fields, options are `NORMAL`, `COMPACT`. For QR code and polling fields, options are `SMALL`, `MEDIUM`, `LARGE`.

alignment.description: A string that specifies the button alignment.  Options are `CENTER`, `LEFT`, `RIGHT`.

background_color.description: A string that specifies the button background color. The value must be a valid hexadecimal color.

border_color.description: A string that specifies the button border color. The value must be a valid hexadecimal color.

display_default_theme_button_background_.description: A boolean that specifies whether the button uses the default theme background color.  Defaults to `false`.

display_default_theme_button_border_colo.description: A boolean that specifies whether the button uses the default theme border color.  Defaults to `false`.

display_default_theme_button_text_color.description: A boolean that specifies whether the button uses the default theme text color.  Defaults to `false`.

display_default_theme_link_color.description: A boolean that specifies whether the default theme link color is enabled.  Defaults to `false`.

enabled.description: A boolean that specifies whether the button is enabled.

height.description: An integer that specifies a custom height of the field (in pixels) when displayed in the form.

bottom.description: An integer that specifies the bottom padding (in pixels) to apply to the field.

left.description: An integer that specifies the left padding (in pixels) to apply to the field.

right.description: An integer that specifies the right padding (in pixels) to apply to the field.

top.description: An integer that specifies the top padding (in pixels) to apply to the field.

padding.description: A single object that specifies custom padding styles for the field.

text_color.description: A string that specifies the button text color. The value must be a valid hexadecimal color.

width.description: An integer that specifies the button width. Set as a percentage.

width_unit.description: A string that specifies the unit to apply to the `width` parameter.  Options are `PERCENT`, `PIXELS`.

styles.description: Optional when the `type` is one of `FLOW_BUTTON`, `FLOW_LINK`, `SOCIAL_LOGIN_BUTTON`, `SUBMIT_BUTTON`.  A single object that describes style settings for the field.

theme.description: **Required** when the `type` is one of `RECAPTCHA_V2`.  A string that specifies the reCAPTCHA theme.  Options are `DARK`, `LIGHT`.

title_enabled.description: **Required** when the `type` is one of `AGREEMENT`.  Specifies whether the title is enabled.

trigger.description: **Required** when the `type` is one of `FIDO2`.  A string that specifies the FIDO2 UI trigger type.  Options are `AUTOMATIC`, `BUTTON`.

type.description: A string that specifies the type of form field.  Options are `AGREEMENT`, `CHECKBOX`, `COMBOBOX`, `DEVICE_AUTHENTICATION`, `DEVICE_REGISTRATION`, `DIVIDER`, `DROPDOWN`, `EMPTY_FIELD`, `ERROR_DISPLAY`, `FIDO2`, `FLOW_BUTTON`, `FLOW_LINK`, `PASSWORD`, `PASSWORD_VERIFY`, `PHONE_NUMBER`, `POLLING`, `QR_CODE`, `RADIO`, `RECAPTCHA_V2`, `SINGLE_CHECKBOX`, `SLATE_TEXTBLOB`, `SOCIAL_LOGIN_BUTTON`, `SUBMIT_BUTTON`, `TEXT`.

validate_phone_number.description: Optional when the `type` is one of `PHONE_NUMBER`.  Whether to validate the phone number input.  Defaults to `true`.

error_message.description: A string that specifies the error message to be displayed when the field validation fails.  When configuring this parameter, the `regex` parameter is required.

regex.description: A string that specifies a validation regular expression. The expression must be a valid regular expression string. This is a required property when the validation type is `CUSTOM`.

type.description: A string that specifies the validation type.  Options are `CUSTOM`, `NONE`.

validation.description: **Required** when the `type` is one of `TEXT`, optional when the `type` is one of `PASSWORD`, `PASSWORD_VERIFY`.  An object containing validation data for the field.

key.description: A non-unique string associated with the field when visibility is evaluated by DaVinci at runtime. If the `visibility.type` property is set to `SHOW_BY_DEFAULT` or `HIDE_BY_DEFAULT`, then this property is required.

type.description: A string that specifies the visibility behavior for the field.  Options are `ALWAYS_VISIBLE`, `HIDE_BY_DEFAULT`, `SHOW_BY_DEFAULT`.

visibility.description: An object that specifies the visibility settings for a form field.

fields.description: An ordered list of objects that specifies the form fields that make up the form.

components.description: A single object that specifies the form configuration elements.

environment_id.description: The ID of the environment to manage the form in.  Must be a valid PingOne resource ID.  This field is immutable and will trigger a replace plan if changed.

name.description: A string that specifies the form name, which must be provided and must be unique within an environment.

environment_id.description: The ID of the environment to associate the agreement with.  Must be a valid PingOne resource ID.  This field is immutable and will trigger a replace plan if changed.

name.description: A string that specifies the name of the agreement to configure.

environment_id.description: The ID of the environment to create the language in.

locale.description: An ISO standard language code. For more information about standard language codes, see [ISO Language Code Table](http://www.lingoes.net/en/translator/langcode.htm).  The following language codes are reserved as they are created automatically in the environment: `cs`, `de`, `en`, `es`, `fr`, `fr-CA`, `hu`, `it`, `ja`, `ko`, `nl`, `pl`, `pt`, `ru`, `th`, `tr`, `zh`.

environment_id.description: The ID of the environment to configure the risk policy in.  Must be a valid PingOne resource ID.  This field is immutable and will trigger a replace plan if changed.

name.description: A string that specifies the unique, friendly name for this policy set. Valid characters consist of any Unicode letter, mark (such as, accent, umlaut), # (numeric), / (forward slash), . (period), ' (apostrophe), _ (underscore), space, or - (hyphen). Maximum size is 256 characters.

resource_id.description: A string that specifies the UUID of the custom PingOne resource. The resource defines the characteristics of the OAuth 2.0 access tokens used to get access to the APIs on the API service such as the audience and scopes. This property must identify a PingOne resource with a `type` property value of `CUSTOM`.

type.description: A string that specifies the type of authorization server that will issue access tokens. Must be the same value as the `directory.type` field. If `EXTERNAL`, the `resource` field must not be provided.  Options are `EXTERNAL`, `PINGONE_SSO`.  Defaults to `PINGONE_SSO`.  This field is immutable and will trigger a replace plan if changed.

authorization_server.description: A single object that specifies properties related to the authorization server that will issue access tokens used to access the APIs.

base_urls.description: A set of strings that specifies the possible base URLs that an end-user will use to access the APIs hosted on the customer's API service. Multiple base URLs may be specified to support cases where the same API may be available from multiple URLs (for example, from a user-friendly domain URL and an internal domain URL). Base URLs must be valid absolute URLs with the `https` or `http` scheme. If the path component is non-empty, it must not end in a trailing slash. The path must not contain empty backslash, dot, or double-dot segments. It must not have a query or fragment present, and the host portion of the authority must be a DNS hostname or valid IP (IPv4 or IPv6). The length must be less than or equal to 256 characters.

environment_id.description: The ID of the environment to create and manage the API Service in.  Must be a valid PingOne resource ID.  This field is immutable and will trigger a replace plan if changed.

name.description: A string that specifies the API service resource name. The name value must be unique among all API services, and it must be a valid resource name.

environment_id.description: PingOne environment identifier (UUID) in which the verify policy exists.  Must be a valid PingOne resource ID.  This field is immutable and will trigger a replace plan if changed.

name.description: Name of the verification policy displayed in PingOne Admin UI.

card_design_template.description: An SVG formatted image containing placeholders for the credentials fields that need to be displayed in the image.

environment_id.description: PingOne environment identifier (UUID) in which the credential type exists.  Must be a valid PingOne resource ID.  This field is immutable and will trigger a replace plan if changed.

background_image.description: The URL or fully qualified path to the image file used for the credential background.  This can be retrieved from the `uploaded_image.href` parameter of the `pingone_image` resource.  Image size must not exceed 50 KB.

bg_opacity_percent.description: A numnber indicating the percent opacity of the background image in the credential. High percentage opacity may make text on the credential difficult to read.

card_color.description: A string containing a 6-digit hexadecimal color code specifying the color of the credential.

columns.description: Indicates a number (between 1-3) of columns to display visible fields on the credential.

attribute.description: Name of the PingOne Directory attribute. Present if `field.type` is `Directory Attribute`.

file_support.description: Specifies how an image is stored in the credential field.  Options are `BASE64_STRING`, `INCLUDE_FILE`, `REFERENCE_FILE`.

id.description: Identifier of the field formatted as `<fields.type> -> <fields.title>`.

is_visible.description: Specifies whether the field should be visible to viewers of the credential.

required.description: Specifies whether the field is required for the credential.

title.description: Descriptive text when showing the field.

type.description: Specifies the type of data in the credential field.  Options are `Alphanumeric Text`, `Directory Attribute`, `Issued Timestamp`.

value.description: The text to appear on the credential for a `field.type` of `Alphanumeric Text`.

fields.description: In a credential, the information is stored as key-value pairs where `fields` defines those key-value pairs. Effectively, `fields.title` is the key and its value is `fields.value` or extracted from the PingOne Directory attribute named in `fields.attribute`.

logo_image.description: The URL or fully qualified path to the image file used for the credential logo.  This can be retrieved from the `uploaded_image.href` parameter of the `pingone_image` resource.  Image size must not exceed 25 KB.

text_color.description: A string containing a 6-digit hexadecimal color code specifying the color of the credential text.

metadata.description: Contains the names, data types, and other metadata related to the credential.

title.description: Title of the credential. Verification sites are expected to be able to request the issued credential from the compatible wallet app using the title.  This value aligns to `${cardTitle}` in the `card_design_template`.
